sourceTitle: 4th of July RASPBERRY, WHITE & BLUEBERRY FARM TO TABLE Cocktail From Harvest Spirits
sourceText:
4th of July RASPBERRY, WHITE & BLUEBERRY FARM TO TABLE Cocktail From Harvest Spirits
By: harvest spirits
Published: Friday, July 5, 2013 - 5:31pm

Ingredients




3oz Harvest Spirits Black Raspberry Vodka
1oz Tonic Water
Splash of Cranberry Juice
Garnish with a Slice of Locally Grown Apples  and Blueberries
Serve in Chilled Cocktail Glass

Preparation

1 Combine 3oz Harvest Spirits Black Raspberry Vodka, 1oz Tonic Water and add a Splash of Cranberry Juice. Garnish with a Slice of Locally Grown Apple, slit to secure to glass and attach blueberries with a tooth pick. Serve in chilled cocktail glass
